basis: Independent planning estimate: A$1,000/year repair savings for an original Model Y, not an observed average repair bill. Over ten years this builds A$10,000: an illustrative pool for occasional uncovered thermal, suspension and electrical work. Australian examples include one A$1,823 fitted aftermarket upper-arm pair and a rough A$2,000–4,000+ compressor guide; neither establishes how often repairs occur. Same-age RWD and Long Range use the same fund because evidence does not justify a precise frequency difference. A$400–2,500 are alternative annual savings budgets, not statistical bounds. Excludes servicing, tyres and insured crashes; use warranty/recall remedies first. Unspent savings remain cash. Major battery replacement can exceed the pool.

Independent planning estimate: A$700/year repair savings for newer Juniper, not an observed average repair bill. Excludes servicing, tyres and insured crashes; claim warranty/recall remedies first. Unspent funds remain cash and a major traction-battery event can exceed the pool.
